decision_boundary: A person exits to fresh air before touching equipment. Relay warning from safety and call 911.

interaction: Water advisory versus standard treatment or infant preparation
decision_boundary: Utility orders control uses. Chemical and Do Not Use require approved alternatives. Infant food safety is a separate prerequisite.

interaction: General lay CPR versus pediatric and drowning context
decision_boundary: Report age and cause. Dispatch and current training govern breaths, AED and resuscitation. No lay fixed cold delay.

interaction: Exertional heat versus indoor classic heat and impaired alertness
decision_boundary: Activate EMS and cool. Airway support and means affect immersion. Give nothing by mouth to an impaired patient.

interaction: Internal gas or CO versus external airborne chemical shelter order
decision_boundary: Exit on an internal hazard. Use specified room/ventilation instructions only for the external incident and local order.

interaction: Lowest interior tornado shelter versus low ground threatened by flood
decision_boundary: Prefer sturdy appropriate shelter. A low outdoor option is conditional. Turn around at floodwater and prioritize official directions.

interaction: Wildfire particles versus CO, chemical gases and unsafe heat
decision_boundary: Particulate protection does not control CO or gas. Move early to a safely reachable cooled cleaner-air setting or promptly when ordered.

interaction: Outage clock estimates versus per-food cold-chain safety
decision_boundary: Use actual cold history and the correct refrigerated or frozen chart; shelf-life and outage duration are separate.

interaction: Conceptual visuals versus regulated installation or validated process
decision_boundary: Use mechanism figures for relationships. Exact approved method and licensed installation directions remain separate.

interaction: Personal SMS fallback or shelter registration versus emergency activation
decision_boundary: Use voice 911 when possible, follow local 911 options, and use the locally identified reunification channel.
